original.statement: Crossplane now validates the Kubernetes resource name before applying a composite resource (XR); the evidence does not say what happens on failure or which environments are exposed.

decision.reason: [ev-b0185d1375a7] says only that Crossplane now validates the Kubernetes resource name before applying an XR. That supports a behavior change in how XRs are applied, and the name xr-resource-name-validation is built from the note's own key words. The note does not say whether names that worked before are now rejected, so validation-tightened is not supported and behavior-changed is the cautious type. No other subject family fits better.
